title: 第644章 虚虚实实的宇宙真相第643章 风险是值得的
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
混沌不记年，一朝分两仪。
最初的宇宙自然分化出清浊二气，以分虚实，一正一反，一表一里，两种本源同时诞生、共生共存。
两极力量完全不同，由此撑起了整个宇宙的根基。
其中一界是现实物质世界，称为实界（世界）。
这里的力量厚重、沉实，一点点凝聚成土地、山川、星辰万物，是纯粹的物质天地，承载着一切看得见、摸得着的实物。
另外一界是虚无能量世界（虚界）。
这里没有实体，只有无穷无尽、流转不停的本源能量，灵动不息、永无静止，是世间一切能量与虚意的源头。
一实一虚，一质一能。
两个世界相互拉扯、相互牵引，一边对抗、一边交融，持续扩张亿万年，最终形成了辽阔无边的浩瀚宇宙。
现实世界与能量世界不再彻底隔绝，它们一点点互相渗透、交融、磨合。
在这种虚实交织的造化下，宇宙迎来了最重要的奇迹——生命，诞生了。
实界馈赠肉身，以厚重物质凝造筋骨血肉，给生灵扎根天地的形体；
虚界赐予神魂，以流转能量孕育灵识心念，让死寂躯壳拥有翱翔天地的灵魂。
肉身加灵魂，物质加能量。
两界的造化合二为一，从此世间的生命，真正拥有了形与神，完整鲜活，不再是死物。
但造化从一开始，就藏着错位与破绽。
实界更稳固、更容易孕育生机，生命率先在现实世界扎根、发芽、繁衍壮大。
从世间第一声生灵心跳响起的那一刻，表里两界维持了亿万年的完美平衡，就悄悄裂开了。
随着族群繁衍，众生不断打磨肉身。
因为生灵生在现实世界，自然就更倾向于利用现实物质打造肉身，而灵魂的成长速度，远远不如。

强悍的肉身，带来更长久的寿命，就会消耗并霸占更多的现实物质，而灵魂方面的低消耗让能量世界的消耗低得多。
因此，实界在和虚界的默默对峙中，渐渐落入下风、愈发虚弱。
最开始，这场交换微不足道，对广阔的宇宙来说，只是滴水入沧海，几乎无大影响。
但平衡一旦破碎，就只会越偏越远，倾覆的结局，早已注定，只是时间早晚。
虚界自然就变得强势，祂开始用能量对实界进行侵蚀，祂在实界与自身的薄弱连接之处，形成了灵气大螺旋臂。
“你的意思是，远古洪荒就是这宇宙中最先诞生生命之地，也因为他们，洪荒是最早形成灵气大螺旋臂的地方？”
邻关城安全稽查部部长官邸的地下室内，八卦洞天的次元通道缓缓敞开。
通道四周，数十只隐形哮天犬悄然巡弋，气息蛰伏，牢牢镇守着这片秘境入口，戒备森严。
content_en:
Chaos does not remember the year, but one day is divided into two rituals.
The original universe naturally differentiated into two qi, pure and turbid, to distinguish reality and reality, one positive and one negative, one appearance and one interior. The two origins were born at the same time and coexisted.
The forces of the two poles are completely different, thus supporting the foundation of the entire universe.
One of them is the real material world, called the real world (world).
The power here is thick and solid, condensed bit by bit into land, mountains, rivers, stars, and all things. It is a pure material world, carrying all visible and tangible objects.
The other world is the world of void energy (virtual world).
There is no entity here, only the endless and constantly flowing source energy, which is constantly dynamic and never static. It is the source of all energy and virtuality in the world.
One real and one empty, one quality and one energy.
The two worlds pulled and pulled each other, confronting and blending at the same time, and continued to expand for hundreds of millions of years, eventually forming a vast and boundless universe.
The real world and the energy world are no longer completely isolated. They penetrate, blend and blend into each other bit by bit.
Under this intertwining of reality and reality, the universe ushered in the most important miracle - life, was born.
The real world gives a physical body as a gift, using heavy matter to condense muscles, bones, flesh and blood, giving living beings a form rooted in heaven and earth;
The virtual world bestows a soul, which uses circulating energy to breed spiritual consciousness and thoughts, allowing the dead body to have a soul that can soar into the world.
Body plus soul, matter plus energy.
The creations of the two worlds merged into one. From then on, the life in the world truly had form and spirit, was complete and living, and was no longer a dead thing.
But there have been misalignments and flaws in creation since the very beginning.
The real world is more stable and more likely to breed vitality. Life takes the lead in taking root, sprouting, multiplying and growing in the real world.
From the moment the first heartbeat of a living being sounded in the world, the inner and outer worlds, which had maintained a perfect balance for hundreds of millions of years, quietly tore apart.
As the race multiplies, all living beings continue to polish their bodies.
Because living beings are born in the real world, they are naturally more inclined to use real materials to build their bodies, while the growth rate of souls is far slower.
A strong physical body, which brings a longer lifespan, will consume and occupy more real matter, while the low consumption of the soul makes the consumption of the energy world much lower.
Therefore, in the silent confrontation with the virtual world, the real world gradually falls into a disadvantage and becomes weaker.
In the beginning, this exchange was insignificant. To the vast universe, it was just a drop of water pouring into the ocean, with almost no big impact.
But once the balance is broken, it will only drift further and further away. The overturning outcome is already destined, it's just a matter of time.
The virtual world naturally became stronger, and it began to use energy to erode the real world. It formed a large spiral arm of spiritual energy at the weak connection between the real world and itself.
"You mean, the ancient wilderness was the first place where life was born in the universe, and because of them, the ancient wilderness was the first place where the great spiral arm of spiritual energy was formed?"
In the basement of the official residence of the Minister of Security Inspection Department in neighboring city, the dimensional passage of Bagua Cave slowly opened.
Around the passage, dozens of invisible roaring dogs patrolled quietly, their auras dormant, firmly guarding the entrance to this secret realm, and they were heavily guarded.
